body:
Worker08 proposes sodium ammonium hydrogenphosphate tetrahydrate, CAS7783-13-3, in `if-new-sodium-ammonium-phosphate-tetrahydrate` at published head `7efd3f8b98f9e822431dcb510c2c242a2569cfc7`. Its payload cites Thermo product040320.22 for CAS, formula H13NNaO8P and molecular weight209.067. The bound capture `research/inorganic_forms/captures/primary-batch6.json` (SHA256 `ba99c6a674d310ec4b7d8d418af86218cd3fff4a7d1b7665c1d9898d121b4021`) contains the product title/opening response but no CAS7783-13-3 or the claimed property table. It must not stand as property evidence.

This is an evidence-binding gap, not evidence that the tetrahydrate identity is wrong. Worker07 independently captured substantive official supplier/SDS evidence for the same exact salt. Reconcile the two new-owner proposals into one final payload with explicit captured primary support, preserving all source-specific cases and the eight generic-label occurrences whose forms remain unresolved. Independently establish the closest supported broad parent: the proposals currently differ between CHEBI:190300 and CHEBI:37586. Neither parent may be an exact identity.

The coordinator should retain the incomplete response honestly, bind the substantive capture and its original retrieval provenance, review every retained property and the final parent choice, and obtain an independent review of the combined payload before guarded application. No existing owner merge, scientific hold withdrawal or mapping release approval follows.

Exact source/delta evidence is X02 in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/cross-shard-reconciliation-v1/groups.json` and `reconciliation-assessment.json`; the sealed packet manifest SHA256 is `f5cfc350aa167b7a3ffa75a5c8b5e5f19d42f95e0a5ad09d7e7c05b5344da03a`. The worker08 payload SHA256 is `74e2cca44589dc54aab6363a06a9cb9b1c535eaad86e131f18f63d19956c91a6`. Root verified that payload and the exact capture; the CAS string is absent from the captured response. Current issue searches returned no matching CAS/evidence-binding finding.
title: Bind substantive primary evidence when reconciling the CAS7783-13-3 proposals
